name: C. V. Raman
summary: C. V. Raman advanced the study of light scattering and helped build modern Indian science.

facts.text: Raman received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics for work on the scattering of light.
facts.context: His achievement helped show that world-class experimental science could be built from Indian institutions and questions.
